statement: The record indicates the invoice was already paid in full on 3 September (reference PAY-2291) even though its status still shows unpaid.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts the record contradicts itself — "already paid in full on 3 September (reference PAY-2291) even though its status still shows unpaid" — identifying the unpaid status as the erroneous value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
